_note: Knowledge base for the Phase 9 lite rules (plan M4). Versioned with the rules: raise version on every change. Every rule names the references in clinical/scenarios/citations.json it rests on. Codes: RxNorm (prescribed products), LOINC (susceptibility results), SNOMED CT (organisms, specimens), ICD-10-CM (problems). Group inducible-ampc holds IDSA 2026's moderate-risk AmpC organisms (Enterobacter cloacae complex, Klebsiella aerogenes, Citrobacter freundii, Hafnia alvei) by SNOMED CT code; 62592009 is one concept that also carries the former name Enterobacter aerogenes. IDSA's low-risk Serratia, Morganella and Providencia are deliberately not in it.

28-1.cuti_caution: IDSA 2025 advises using amoxicillin cautiously and with optimized dosing in complicated UTI.

85422-4.oral_step_down: an oral cephalosporin the cefazolin urinary surrogate supports, such as cefpodoxime

141-2.oral_step_down: an oral third-generation cephalosporin such as cefpodoxime

community-acquired-pneumonia.duration_text: ATS 2025 suggests fewer than 5 days (at least 3) once clinically stable in nonsevere pneumonia, and 5 days or more in severe pneumonia

why._note: One fixed line per rule (and variant) that the finding's data carries as 'Why it matters', so the model restates a reviewed reason instead of writing its own; 'key' is the term try_explanations.py checks the explanation keeps (owner decision, 2026-11-12).

bug-drug-mismatch.text: the isolate tests resistant to the current antimicrobial, so it is not expected to treat this infection

ampc-third-generation-cephalosporin.text: the organism can derepress an inducible AmpC during therapy and become resistant to third-generation cephalosporins even when it first tests susceptible; completing an empirically started course is reasonable only in a non-severe, improving, source-controlled infection

ampc-third-generation-cephalosporin/febr.text: the organism can derepress an inducible AmpC during therapy and become resistant to third-generation cephalosporins even when it first tests susceptible; the exception for an empirically started course needs clinical improvement, which ongoing fever argues against

mssa-vancomycin.text: for methicillin-susceptible S. aureus bacteremia, an anti-staphylococcal beta-lactam is preferred over vancomycin

meningitis-listeria.text: Listeria monocytogenes is intrinsically resistant to cephalosporins and is not covered by vancomycin

double-anaerobic-coverage.text: the other agent already covers anaerobes, so the second anaerobic agent adds no coverage

duration-review.text: antibiotics continued past the recommended course add adverse effects and resistance pressure

iv-to-po-switch.text: switching a clinically stable patient to an effective oral agent avoids IV catheter complications and cost
